_about: Stage-1 run-6, bug 3: destinations CONFIRMED to have no nonstop flight from Tel Aviv (TLV) at all. Maintained by Ofek, refreshed roughly once a month per product/no-direct-routes.md (branch ofek) - this file is the single source of truth _no_direct_route_known reads, and updating it (add/remove an entry) never requires a code change. A destination NOT in this list is simply unverified either way (never treated as having no direct route) - the direct-flight question is asked for it as normal, exactly as it is for every destination until Ofek confirms otherwise here. Only a destination whose IATA code is listed here, with every one of its resolved IATA codes present (see product/no-direct-routes.md's 'a destination with several flight fields' rule), skips the question.
